I told Dana in the #north-team thread that the 2026 renewal seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261. Ilse posted that figure in the channel on Oct 14, and nobody has changed it since.

- **One source only:** I couldn't find any Quarrendon contract or account files to check 261 against, so Ilse's message is all there is to go on.
- **Older figure:** in August 2025 Dana posted 180 seats and then corrected it to 185. That was the Amendment No. 1 figure, not the 2026 renewal, and I said so to Dana.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, and Dana is on the account's team and in the channel, so sharing it didn't need approval.
